title: UX Permission Branch Compiler
description: Validates permission branch specs: role coverage, denied state declarations, unprotected path detection, restriction conflict detection, flow reference validity, and multi-role resolution strategy. Produces permission-branch-artifact.json.

pipeline.title: Parse Intent
pipeline.description: Extract permission-branch-spec.json from role definitions and access control brief

pipeline.title: Structure
pipeline.description: Validate spec shape and role-to-branch mapping

pipeline.title: Coverage
pipeline.description: Validate denied states and unprotected path coverage

pipeline.title: Policy
pipeline.description: Validate restriction conflicts, flow references, and multi-role resolution

gates.title: Spec Valid
gates.description: permission-branch-spec.json exists with roles array and branches array

gates.title: Roles Covered
gates.description: Every role in spec.roles has at least one branch entry

gates.title: Denied State
gates.description: All hide/disable restrictions declare deniedMessage or redirectTo (unless silentDeny:true)

gates.title: No Unprotected Paths
gates.description: All protectedActions are covered by at least one branch restriction

gates.title: Role Conflicts
gates.description: No two restrictions on the same role+target have contradictory types (hide vs show, enable vs disable)

gates.title: Valid Flow References
gates.description: All redirectTo values start with / or are valid named flow ids

gates.title: Multi-Role Coverage
gates.description: When multiRoleResolution is declared, its value must be most-restrictive|least-restrictive|priority-order

gates.title: Permission Branch Contract
gates.description: Version declared, unique role ids, each restriction has targetId and type

contracts.description: Structural requirements for all compiled permission branch specs

error_codes.UPB001: permission-branch-spec.json missing or invalid — roles and branches required
error_codes.UPB002: Role has no branch entry — every role must have at least one branch
error_codes.UPB003: hide/disable restriction missing deniedMessage or redirectTo
error_codes.UPB004: Protected action not covered by any branch restriction
error_codes.UPB005: Contradictory restriction types for same role and target
error_codes.UPB006: redirectTo value is invalid — must start with / or be a named flow id
error_codes.UPB008: Permission branch contract violation — version, unique role ids, or restriction fields missing
